tickets.title: Model lists come from the harnesses, the catalog is the fallback
tickets.what:
**Why:** owner 2026-11-14 asked how the selectable models are obtained. Today they are a hand-kept list
(`packages/hud-mcp/catalog.json` + `$HUD_HOME/harnesses.json` `catalog`), which goes stale.

**What to build:** `placeCatalog` models for pi, agy and grok come from the harness's own list command
(`pi --list-models`, `agy models`, `grok models`), run only when the Control plane page opens or on its refresh key,
never on the refresh tick, bounded (timeout, output cap, no shell), cached under `$HUD_HOME/display` for about a
day. claude and codex keep the catalog list (no list command). A failed or missing command falls back to the
catalog silently. The owner can type a model name on a role row (one-line input); a typed model is saved in the role
and offered again. Model ids only: never read or show credentials or provider config beyond the id.

input pattern is not already there · **Size:** about 150 source lines

tickets.title: `oracle` is a local advisor; `pro` is the browser role
tickets.what:
**Why (owner 2026-11-14):** "oracle was put under browser tasks; this logical role should be a local model; list GPT 6
Pro separately as pro." For this project the oracle runs on Fable for now.

**What to build:**
- New shipped role `pro` with the places the shipped `oracle` has today (bro: ChatGPT 6 Pro → Gemini → AI Studio
  gemini-4-argon); it is in the Control plane's Browser tasks group with `flow`.
- Shipped `oracle` becomes a local read-only advisor: `instructions: "oracle"`, `can_continue: false`, run
  `[cli claude model fable, pi pi_role architect]`. Add `packages/hud-mcp/instructions/oracle.md` (read-only: answer
  the brief's design question with facts and file:line, mark guesses, no edits/builds/commits, write the answer to the
  report path). It is in the Roles group, not Browser tasks.
- Everything that names oracle as a browser role follows (roster, Control plane groups, convention text, docs
  `reference.md`/`.zh.md`, `.scratch/role-bind/spec.md` item 3, tests).

**Size:** small (role files, one instructions file, group lists, tests)

acceptance.text: `hud_roster` lists `oracle` (cli/claude fable, fallback pi architect) and `pro` (bro chatgpt 6 Pro, fallbacks)
Control plane: oracle under Roles, pro and flow under Browser tasks
`hud_create role=pro` dispatches a browser task; `hud_create role=oracle` starts claude with `--model fable` (fake herdr), with the oracle instructions in the brief
